target_countries.name: Germany
target_countries.dependant_visa_policy: Dependants (spouse and minor children) are eligible for family reunification visa (Familiennachzug) if sufficient living funds and adequate health insurance are proven.
target_countries.immigration_disclaimer: Dependants appear eligible under current published German residence act (§ 29-32 AufenthG); verify requirements before applying.

target_countries.name: Hong Kong
target_countries.dependant_visa_policy: Full-time doctoral students in Hong Kong may sponsor their legal spouse and unmarried dependent children under 18 for dependant visas with right to study and reside.
target_countries.immigration_disclaimer: Dependants appear eligible under current published Hong Kong Immigration Department guidance; verify requirements before applying.

target_countries.name: Canada
target_countries.dependant_visa_policy: Spouses/common-law partners of full-time doctoral (PhD) students remain eligible for an Open Work Permit (SOWP); dependent children may attend public school.
target_countries.immigration_disclaimer: Dependants appear eligible under current published IRCC guidelines for doctoral students; verify requirements before applying.

target_countries.name: United Kingdom
target_countries.dependant_visa_policy: International postgraduate research (PhD/Doctoral) students are explicitly permitted to bring family dependants (partner and children) on Student Dependant Visas.
target_countries.immigration_disclaimer: Dependants appear eligible under current published UK Visas and Immigration guidance for research doctorates; verify requirements before applying.

target_countries.name: Japan
target_countries.dependant_visa_policy: International doctoral students holding a College Student (Ryugaku) visa may sponsor spouse and children under a Dependent (Kazoku Taizai) status of residence.
target_countries.immigration_disclaimer: Dependants appear eligible under current published Immigration Services Agency of Japan guidelines; verify requirements before applying.

target_countries.name: United States
target_countries.dependant_visa_policy: Spouses and unmarried minor children of F-1/J-1 doctoral students are eligible for F-2 or J-2 derivative status. J-2 spouses may apply for work authorization (EAD).
target_countries.immigration_disclaimer: Dependants appear eligible under current published US Department of State visa regulations; verify requirements before applying.
